featured_reviews.name: Ashley Anil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Management Team, seema Hospital,

I am writing this message to formally express my concern and disappointment regarding the overall patient handling and communication standards at your hospital.

My family and I have been visiting seema Hospital for the past 3 years. Unfortunately, throughout this entire period, we have consistently experienced very poor communication from the front desk and support staff. The behavior and response quality have not improved over time. Staff members often lack basic communication etiquette when speaking with patients and their families, both in person and over phone calls.

When we call to ask about doctor timings or appointment schedules, we are frequently given unclear or incorrect information. On multiple occasions, staff members have not even been aware of the correct timings. This creates confusion and inconvenience, especially for patients who may be unwell or elderly.

In addition, the waiting time is extremely long. We have had to sit and wait for two to three hours just to see the doctor, even after confirming availability. There is very little guidance or update provided during this waiting period.

I want to clearly state that the only reason we continue to visit this hospital is because of Dr. Zulfiqar. He is extremely kind, knowledgeable, and professional. He understands my aunt, Shivanti’s, medical needs very well and treats patients with care and respect. Our trust is with him personally. If he were not associated with this hospital, we would not choose to continue treatment here.

Therefore, I humbly request the hospital management to please conduct a proper service review, patient feedback survey, or surprise inspection of staff behavior and communication practices. Training in patient interaction and basic communication etiquette is seriously needed.

We value good medical care, but patient experience and respectful communication are equally important. I hope the management will take this feedback seriously and work toward improving the situation.

Sincerely,Ashley

Restoration of alignment.
Stable closure.

Because in hand surgery, millimeters matter.
Tension matters.
Technique matters.

A clean repair.
A scar that will barely be visible in six weeks.

This is why we do what we do.

Upgrade yourself so quietly that one day your work speaks for you.

Onwards and upwards. 🚀
